title: Your calendar: add, move, cancel and block
summary: Every booking in one place. Add the ones that come by phone, move or cancel, and block time off.

steps.title: Open Calendar
steps.body: Tap Calendar in the bar at the bottom. You see each day's bookings: who, what, when, and where they came from (your page, you, or a Tikka).

steps.title: Add a booking
steps.body: Someone booked by phone or in person? Tap "Add a booking", pick the service and time, and add their first name and WhatsApp number so you can remind them and send their pass.

steps.title: Move or cancel
steps.body: Tap a booking, then "Move booking" to pick a new time, or "Cancel booking". Either way the old time becomes free again. If they paid a deposit, Tikka reminds you: any refund comes from you.

steps.title: Mark who came
steps.body: After a booking's time, Calendar asks "Did they come?". Tap "Came in" or No-show, so your customers and money stay right.

steps.title: Block a time
steps.body: Going out, or a day off? Tap "Block a time" and pick the times. Nobody can book them until you remove the block.

steps.title: Waitlist for full days
steps.body: When a day is full, customers can wait for a place. You see them on Calendar. When a place opens, tap "Tell" next to their name and WhatsApp opens on your phone with a message ready. Tap Done when they're sorted.
